capabilities: Send chosen folders or single notes to the Asyntai knowledge base
Keep knowledge base entries in sync on edit, rename and delete
Ask the chatbot questions in a panel and insert answers into notes
Read website conversations and visitor leads
disambiguation: It is not a local AI assistant; it only works with the Asyntai service for websites.
extras: Requires a paid Asyntai plan (Starter or higher); notes under 120 characters are skipped and embeds and images are dropped when sent.
problem: Website chatbot owners have no way to feed their Obsidian notes into their site assistant or read visitor conversations from inside the vault.
summary: Integration that sends vault notes to the Asyntai website chatbot's knowledge base and lets you chat with it and read site chats and leads.
